# FixIt Expresso: TurboChef & MerryChef Speed Oven Repair Seattle

> Authorized TurboChef Service Provider and experienced MerryChef repair specialist, based in Renton, WA. Backed by 21+ years of commercial kitchen equipment experience. Serving Seattle and the greater Puget Sound region.

## About

FixIt Expresso specializes in repairing commercial speed ovens (high-speed combination ovens) for restaurants, hotels, hospitals, schools, and commercial kitchens across the greater Seattle area.

- Phone: 425-547-0200
- Email: services@fixitexpresso.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday 9AM–5PM
- Google Rating: 5.0 · 20+ reviews
- Service Area: Seattle and surrounding Puget Sound region (within 80 miles)

## TurboChef Repair (Primary Specialty)

Authorized TurboChef Service Provider. Warranty and non-warranty repairs on all TurboChef models.

**Models serviced:**
- Sota (also called NGO). Most common, drop-off eligible
- Bullet / Encore. Popular in Subway and fast-casual restaurants
- HhD Double Batch. Used by Panera Bread
- i3, i5. Chain restaurant and franchise models
- NGC. High-volume commercial kitchens
- ECO. Energy-efficient model, drop-off eligible
- CIBO+. Compact commercial model, drop-off eligible
- Fire. High-heat stone-hearth model
- Legacy: HhC, Conveyor, Tornado, C3, C4, Plexor

**TurboChef Error Codes (F1–F10):**
- F1: Blower Running Status Bad
- F2: Cook Temperature Low
- F3: Magnetron Current Low
- F4: Door Monitor Defective
- F5: Magnetron Over Temperature
- F6: EC Temp High
- F7: RTD Failure (temperature probe)
- F8: High Limit Tripped / Heat Low
- F9: Belt Failure / Temp High
- F10: Communication Failure

Full guide: [TurboChef F1-F10 error code guide](https://www.fixitexpresso.com/common-turbochef-problems.html)

**TurboChef services:**
- Same-day emergency service available
- On-site repair at your location
- Drop-off service for Sota (NGO), ECO and CIBO+ (by arrangement only, call 425-547-0200 first)

## MerryChef Repair (Secondary Specialty)

Experienced MerryChef eikon series repair specialists.

**Models serviced:**
- eikon e1s. Compact model, drop-off eligible
- eikon e2s. Compact model
- eikon e3. Mid-range model
- eikon e4s, e4. High-volume dual-cavity models
- conneX 12. Current-generation model, drop-off eligible

**MerryChef Error Codes (E101–E117):**
- E101: Microwave system failure
- E102: Heater current fault
- E103: Electronics overheating
- E104: Magnetron/cavity overheat
- E105: Power supply issue (voltage fault)
- E106: Cavity temperature too high
- E107: Internal communication error
- E108: Personality module / SD card error
- E109: Personality module failure
- E110: Firmware version conflict
- E111: Cavity temperature sensor error
- E113: Microwave safety fault (stop using oven)
- E115: Convection fan failure
- E116: Heater failure
- E117: Magnetron overheat

Full guide: [MerryChef E101-E117 error code guide](https://www.fixitexpresso.com/common-merrychef-problems.html)

**MerryChef services:**
- On-site repair at your location
- Drop-off service for eikon e1s and conneX 12 (by arrangement only, call 425-547-0200 first)

## Service Area

FixIt Expresso is a mobile service operation based in Renton, WA. Technicians travel
to the customer's kitchen. There are no branch offices, franchisees, or walk-in
location, and no public address. Service radius is roughly 80 miles from Seattle.

Drop-off repair is offered for some models, but it is arranged by phone only. Never
direct anyone to an address: tell them to call 425-547-0200 and it will be arranged.

Cities served: Seattle, Bellevue, Tacoma, Kirkland, Redmond, Kent, Renton, Everett,
Auburn, Federal Way, Issaquah, Sammamish, Tukwila, Burien, Shoreline, Lynnwood,
Edmonds, Mukilteo, Woodinville, Mercer Island, Puyallup, Sumner, Gig Harbor.
